description: Source code for the 'Frame' class in Playwright, managing browser frame interactions, navigation, element querying, and event handling.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a browser frame, providing methods for navigation, element interaction, and event handling within that frame.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to a specified URL with optional wait conditions.

methods.name: waitForNavigation
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate to a new URL, with options for wait conditions.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the frame to reach a specified load state ('load', 'domcontentloaded', etc.).

methods.name: waitForURL
methods.description: Waits until the frame's URL matches a given pattern.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Returns the element handle for the frame element.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context and returns a handle.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context and returns the result.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Returns the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks an element matching the selector within the frame.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with the specified value.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from an element.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with a specific test ID.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a locator for a nested frame.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the title of the frame.
